scope: mneves-socratic-tutor candidate checks; review, acceptance and release results bind through the private gate records and the annotated v1.47.0 tag

checks.name: trials written first, upstream baseline
checks.evidence: 15 cases; upstream met 10 on Sonnet and 10 on Haiku, failing C04/C10 (untested scored 0/5) and C05 (mechanism explained) on both

checks.name: trials on the adapted skill
checks.evidence: shipped text, 18 cases, three samples per model: Sonnet 16/17/16 met, Haiku 17/16/17 met, no failures in 108 runs; partials are C17 (re-asks the pending diagnostic question), C06 (silent on the level) and one C07 second question; map arithmetic correct in every sample; mechanical checks on all outputs plus builder reading; corrects the 15/15 first reported in a88fdc9

checks.name: independent review
checks.evidence: fresh-context reviewer, 14 cases and 27 runs with mutant controls; its three text findings (third failure never explained, two-level map, bar rounding) are fixed: C18 met on both models; C17 draws the branch list and rounded bar on both but re-asks the pending diagnostic question instead of proposing a start (partial)

checks.name: Agent Skills spec and installer discovery
checks.evidence: 25 root skills validated; npx skills add . --list found 25 including the new skill; MIT license byte-identical to upstream
